title: The Three Warriors and the Water of Bethlehem
description: While David was in the stronghold at Adullam and the Philistines had a garrison at Bethlehem, he longed for water from the well by the gate of Bethlehem. Three of his most courageous warriors broke through the enemy camp to fetch the water, but David refused to drink it and poured it out as an offering to the Lord, because it was like the blood of men who risked their lives.
